lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.fill: Bullish fills when a later bar low reaches the lower edge; bearish fills when a later bar high reaches the upper edge.
lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.first_touch: First later bar whose range overlaps the zone emits fvg_first_touch.
lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.formation: Latest three completed bars; bullish: middle close > middle open AND last low > first high; bearish: middle close < middle open AND last high < first low; gap >= 0.2 formation-ATR; middle body >= 0.2 ATR. First bar = origin edge, middle = impulse bar, third completed bar = confirmation and detection event.
lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.lawful_availability: available_time = received_ts_ns of the first source tick whose event_time_ns enters a later bucket; source_sequence is the equal-receipt causal tie-break; bar_close_ts remains the temporal boundary only. No synthetic tail bar; the forming end-of-stream bar is excluded.
lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.leakage_boundary: Formation payload is emitted before later touch/fill processing; touch and fill are later-bar outcomes and cannot define formation-time cohorts.
lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.persistence: Zones remain active until far-edge invalidation; serialized/restored with the detector state envelope.
lifecycle_semantics_from_authority.zone_bounds: Bullish: lower = first high, upper = last low. Bearish: lower = last high, upper = first low.

anchor_object.semantic_derivation_note: The touch predicate (bar RANGE overlaps zone) and the fill predicate (bar EXTREME reaches far edge) are logically distinct: a bar entirely beyond the near edge can satisfy the fill predicate without its range ever overlapping the zone. Anomalous completion modes in CORE-10 are derived from this written predicate structure, not from any observed data.

dependency_caveats.CAVEAT_BG001_CONFLUENCE: Program methodology records that dependency-edge independence is NOT established across supported dependency edges (DO_NOT_CLAIM_INDEPENDENT_CONFLUENCE). Multi-context results are conditional-information findings, never independent-confluence claims.
dependency_caveats.CAVEAT_CROSS_SCALE_IDENTITY: cross_scale_identity is UNRESOLVED_AND_PROHIBITED. No question links zones across timeframes; scale-relationship questions are lawful only as stratified replication/agreement (and, in gated O1, as time-point spatial co-activation without identity).
dependency_caveats.CAVEAT_END_OF_STREAM: No synthetic tail bar; the forming end-of-stream bar is excluded. All duration outcomes are right-censored at end of stream; complete-case deletion is a selection rule, not noise (see CORE-13/O4).
dependency_caveats.CAVEAT_LEAKAGE_BOUNDARY: Formation payload precedes touch/fill processing; touch/fill cannot define formation-time cohorts; all formation-time conditioning uses formation-available information only.
dependency_caveats.CAVEAT_REGISTRY_UNRESOLVED: In the frozen registry all 23 families have semantic_status=UNRESOLVED, empty roles, empty derives_from, availability_semantics UNRESOLVED. No detector-specific semantic relationship may be assumed; E3 context readouts are form-declared (presence-in-window / state-bucket) and must pass the context-resolution gate.
dependency_caveats.CAVEAT_STATE_RESTORE: Zones are serialized/restored with the detector state envelope; age and history computations must exclude windows crossing restore boundaries.

eligibility_rules.ELIGIBILITY_GLOBAL: Anchor decision time a(z) = lawful available_ts_ns of the anchor event (formation event for formation-time conditioning; the stage event for stage-conditioned analyses). Every conditioning quantity must be fully determined by information whose available_ts_ns <= a(z), with source_sequence as the equal-receipt tie-break. Outcome events are credited only if their available_ts_ns > a(z). Context detector readouts obey the same rule; tick-surface outputs are available at received_ts_ns of the emitting tick (same-step emission per PRODUCER_LINKAGE_V2).

exposure_classification_rules.CLASS_RULE_E1_CLOSED: E1 = native phenotype of the zone object using only its own lifecycle, unconditional (marginal distributions, transition frequencies, direction symmetry, plain duration distributions). E1 is FROZEN COMPLETE and CLOSED. The generator proposes zero E1 reopens: blind to the frozen E1 contract contents, no genuine semantic omission can be established, and every own-lifecycle cut below is admitted only in conditional (E2) form.
exposure_classification_rules.CLASS_RULE_E2: E2_SAME_DOMAIN = conditioning information comes from the FVG domain itself: (a) the zone's own lifecycle stage history (stage at decision time, age since formation); (b) sub-rule E2B: the zone's own formation-time semantic attributes (magnitude, direction, bounds geometry) used as conditioners of later-stage outcomes, i.e. conditional rather than marginal structure; (c) sub-rule E2C: same-detector population properties in the same stratum (other zones' states, completed outcomes causally available before the anchor, spatial configuration, population composition rules including censoring rules).
exposure_classification_rules.CLASS_RULE_E3: E3_CROSS_DOMAIN = conditioning on other registered detector families' outputs or instrument-level context: calendar features of lawful availability timestamps, frozen availability-sidecar metadata, or readouts of the 22 non-anchor registered families (subject to the context-resolution gate).

AVAILABILITY_SIDECAR_FIELDS: source_sequence (frozen sidecar fvg_availability_v1; authority metadata, not behavioral outcome)
FORBIDDEN_GLOBAL: post-formation bar/tick information in any formation-time conditioning set (authority leakage_boundary)
anchor zone's own touch/fill/invalidation outcomes used to define formation-time cohorts
cross-scale object identity linkage of any kind
any file under docs/research/ (E1A/E1B results, reviews, challenges, reconciliations, synthesis), .runs/, or scanner source
observed effect sizes, return signs, observed lifecycle frequencies, or outcomes from any prior experiment
external (non-instrument) data surfaces (news calendars, macro releases); only instrument-intrinsic timestamps and the frozen availability sidecar are lawful instrument-level context
FVG_CORE_FIELDS: formation_bar_end_ts (= CompletedBar.end_ts of confirmation bar; temporal boundary only)

minimum_support_rules.MIN_SUPPORT_A: >= 200 eligible anchor units per test cell after exclusions; apply bucket-collapse ladder; if still unsupported the cell is reported UNSUPPORTED (no inference, no claim either way).
minimum_support_rules.MIN_SUPPORT_RARE: For rare-mode analyses (anomalous completion modes): >= 50 events per mode per stratum; below that, pool strata with stratum fixed effects; if still unsupported, UNSUPPORTED.
minimum_support_rules.context_resolution_gate: SF-4 / CORE-06 / CORE-07 / CORE-11 / CORE-08 context cells execute only for (context family, readout form) pairs that at resolution time have semantic_status in {AUTHORITATIVE, PROVISIONAL} and a declared scalar state or event stream compatible with the readout; unresolved pairs are DROPPED_AT_GATE and counted as dropped, not as failures.

multiplicity_families.MF_CORE_PRIMARY: 14 core questions -> 16 predeclared primary test cells; Holm step-down within the family; two-sided tests.
multiplicity_families.MF_OPT: OPTIONAL_LOW_PRIORITY tier is exploratory; no confirmatory claims; reported with nominal p-values and explicit exploratory labels only.
multiplicity_families.MF_SF4: BH-FDR (q=0.05) across the resolvable subset of the 168 SF-4 cells (declared upper bound).

null_library.NULL_CIRCULAR_SHIFT: Circularly shift the context or event series by a random offset within session-bounded blocks (block length >= 1 session), preserving autocorrelation of both series. Mandatory for population-level series (formation counts, rolling histories, context readouts); naive independent row shuffles are INVALID for these series and are prohibited.
null_library.NULL_DAY_SESSION_MATCHED: Permute session-block (or calendar-context) labels among zones within the same UTC day (and same direction where declared), preserving day-level heterogeneity.
null_library.NULL_MATCHED_CONTROL: Within (stratum x direction x formation session block [+ magnitude tercile where declared]), permute the conditioner labels among matched zones. Preserves within-block temporal dependence and session structure. Valid for formation-time and stage-entry conditioning.
null_library.NULL_SESSION_BLOCK_BOOTSTRAP: Resample UTC-day/session blocks with replacement for estimator-agreement deltas (methods-robustness questions only; not a behavioral null).
null_library.NULL_WITHIN_DIRECTION_MATCHED: Matched-control null computed separately within each direction; direction is never permuted across. Default for magnitude/attribute questions.
null_library.NULL_WITHIN_REGIME_MATCHED: Match zones on the declared regime variable (calendar block or context-state bucket) and permute conditioner labels within regime cells. Secondary null for cross-domain conditioning.

readout_forms.presence_in_window: Binary indicator that the context family emitted >= 1 event with available_ts_ns in (a(z) - W, a(z)], W in {16, 64} anchor-stratum bars.
readout_forms.recency_since_last_event: Bucketed time since the family's last event with available_ts_ns <= a(z).
readout_forms.state_bucket: The family's scalar state value at the last availability time <= a(z), bucketed to within-(stratum) terciles; only for families with a declared scalar state at the context-resolution gate.
